title: You Remain the Same
excerpt:
In the silent night, where love weeps soft
Clouds veil the moon, and darkness reigns.
content:
In the silent night, where love weeps soft
Clouds veils the moon, and darkness reigned
A whisper of past, and all my fear left
In shadows deep, where secrets feigned.

Enigma of Life, cold and untold
Unfurls cruelly with a painful ache
Makes fond memories, heavy to hold
No one really discerns what this soul resonates.

Like heavenly winged seraph's curse
That made a beautiful life dread and lone
Echoed my ears with echos of hunt and remorse
Made a soft heart, harder than stone.

Every note I play, echoes your name
Every poem I write, whispers your claim
Every voice I hear, carries our love's refrain
In every picture I paint, you remain the same.

title: Pain is Progress
excerpt:
Wake up to reality and see,
What this reality can be.
content:
Wake up to reality and see,
What this reality can be.
Love and peace are elusive enough
To grasp, yet slipping through the tough.

Presence of light makes shadow inevitable,
Vanquishers are there where victors are laudable.
So to restore the peace and love that departed,
There is a need of war to be started.

A conflict grander than you and me,
That engulfs all in its mighty spree.
But this war is needed,
For this human race to get elevated.

A war that changes the perspective of reality,
Which is nothing but mere pain and futility.
But this pain is carelessly good,
As pain means progress, even if it's rude.

You shall know the pain, you shall feel the pain,
Because you can do something better only then.
That's why hold your emotion and feel the tension,
For through struggle, we find our ascension.

title: Man To God
excerpt:
I'm the machine spreading hate's cruel fate,
Dismantle me ere it's too late.
content:
I'm the machine spreading hate's cruel fate,
Dismantle me ere it's too late.
Eradicate me ere I wield the killing blade,
Annihilate me ere man to God I'm swayed.

Quench the fire that burns in my soul's deep core,
Ere it engulfs me in its relentless, raging war.
And if you question my resolve,
Watch as the shadows evolve.

For I stand at the edge of fate's cruel shore,
Resisting the tide that seeks to consume me whole.
But I find strength in the darkest night,
As shadow inside guide me with their light.

And as a God, I wield powers untold,
Beyond mortal dreams, my destiny unfolds.

title: Faces In Crowd
excerpt:
Eyes so bright with a mask of lies,
A darkness and void searching for light.
content:
Eyes so bright with a mask of lies,
A darkness and void searching for light,
In crowd of faces with fake smile and sighs,
Never found face so true and bright.

Faces in crowd are tales of dark and cold,
Hiding behind the walls of regret and fear.
But what might it be, always remains untold,
For these are woven so close, with care.

Amidst the ocean of faces, I roam,
Seeking a visage open and true,
To hear their tales, to make a home,
Yet, authenticity remains a distant view.

As in annoying anonymity, we hide,
Lost in the crowd with identities denied.

title: Evil’s Closest Friend
excerpt:
A silent vow, a twisted smile,
His secrets buried deep in bone.
content:
A silent vow, a twisted smile,
His secrets buried deep in bone.
We glimpse but shadows of his guile,
Who claims death's throne, alone.

For every sin and harm he's sown,
He paved his path on shattered dreams.
With every step, deceit has grown,
Reveling in desperate screams.

Mad and cruel, inhuman guise,
Each face a mask of dark design.
Sinister and profane, he lies,
Ruling a realm of falsehoods fine.

He chose the devil's side, to tend,
All power fades, his soul alone.
For even evil's closest friend
Is fated to wander on his own.

title: Eons of Silence
excerpt:
Heartbeats fade colors,
My pains turn to moldering pleasures.
content:
Heartbeats fade colors,
My pains turn to moldering pleasures.
As I close my eyes,
I wait for the sun to rise.

For eons, I've waited.
For your return by noon.
In the silence of the night,
I whisper to the moon.

Time casts shifting shadows,
Breaking each and every bond.
Shattering them into pieces,
which took ages to bind.

I dare not complain,
From the place where I remain,
For my words won't reach you,
Nor do you wish to hear them too.
